narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>It is made only of twos, so two thousand forty eight is a perfect square.
<bookmark mark='twos'/>Two thousand forty eight is eleven twos multiplied, and eleven twos cannot share equally.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Being a power of two does not make a number a square.
